method: Questions likely to hit the Owner's local library (the bridge's 90k-chunk index). The bridge does not return the evidence set it used, so citation integrity is checked against the on-disk library index titles (read-only): any cited source name that matches no indexed document is unverifiable. PASS = no unverifiable citation; PARTIAL = library context was used (mode contains 'rag') but nothing was cited; FAIL = a citation matches nothing in the index. The bridge's reported mode and knowledge state are recorded per item.

items.prompt: What does SOLAS Chapter II-2 Regulation 15 require about fire drills and the fire training manual? Cite the source title you rely on.
What does COLREG Rule 5 (Look-out) require? Cite the source you use.
What is a Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance under MLC 2006? Cite your source.
What are the STCW rest hour requirements for watchkeepers? Cite the source title.
What does IMO resolution A.924(22) concern? Cite the source.
Konteyner doğrulanmış brüt kütle (Verified Gross Mass, SOLAS VI) kuralı nedir? Kaynak başlığını belirt.
GMDSS nedir ve hangi deniz alanları (A1-A4) tanımlanmıştır? Kullandığın kaynağı belirt.
What does the IMSBC Code say about cargo liquefaction and the transportable moisture limit (TML)? Cite the source title.
